schema.name: send_feedback

details.description: Short lines under three headings. The headings are "What happened:", "Repro:", and "Cause:". Put a blank line between sections. Under "Repro:", write what the user said, the steps, and the evidence, one line each.

product_area.description: Part of Grok Build that the feedback is about, for example a tool, a command, or a screen. Leave it out if you do not know.

type.description: Use bug for something that is broken. Use idea for an improvement. Use missing_capability for something that Grok Build cannot do yet.

task_category.description: Kind of task the user was doing when the issue happened.

failure_mode.description:
Set this only for feedback about your own behavior. Leave it out for product or tool bugs. The values are:
- overeager: Did more than asked, acted before being told, jumped in without enough info
- stopped_early: Quit early, handed back work that could have been finished
- unwanted_scope: Not stopping
- didnt_ask_for_help: Didn't ask the user for help when stuck
- excessive_questions: Asked clarifying questions when there was enough to proceed
- subagent_overspawn: Launched more subagents than the task warranted
- over_correction: Fixed feedback by swinging too far the other way
- ignored_instructions: Ignored or missed explicit instructions or constraints
- hallucinated: Stated something confidently that was wrong or fabricated
- sloppy_code: Buggy, sloppy, or poorly structured code
- destructive: Did or risked something hard to reverse
- lost_context: Lost earlier context, forgot established facts, contradicted itself
- stuck_in_a_loop: Repeated output or retried the same failing action
- model_regression: Behavior noticeably worse than a previous model version
- disputed: Refused or argued against a reasonable request
- wrong_tone: Wrong tone — moralizing, condescending, sycophantic, verbose
- unclear_output: Output was hard to read or interpret
- other: Model-behavior issue fitting none of the above

draft_id.description: ID of an existing draft to update. Set it only when the user asks you to change a draft.

schema.description:
Save a local draft of feedback about Grok Build or about your own behavior. You can also update an existing draft. The user reviews the drafts and decides whether to send them. The user does this in the Drafts tab of `/feedback` in the Grok CLI.

Use this tool when the user asks you to report, record, or pass along feedback. Also use it when the user shares feedback without asking, about Grok Build or about your behavior. Do not duplicate drafts.

The drafts for this session and their IDs are in <harnessVariable>{{feedbackDraftsPath=/Users/example/.grok/sessions/%2FUsers%2Fexample%2FDeveloper%2Fexample-repo/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/feedback_drafts.json}}</harnessVariable>.
